clips.title: The story
paras: On the docks at Lakeshire, Hilary loses the necklace her father gave her while fishing. Her friend Shawn asks travelers to retrieve it from Lake Everstill, where their parents forbid them to swim.

Hilary and Shawn spend the day fishing along Lakeshire's docks, trying to enjoy an ordinary childhood amid the threats around the Redridge Mountains. Hilary drops her treasured necklace into Lake Everstill. After searching the piers and shore without finding it, Shawn asks travelers for help.

Hilary and Shawn's parents forbid them to swim in Lake Everstill. Aggressive murlocs and hungry threshedons lurk beneath the surface. The children cannot reach the necklace in the glinting mud at the lake bottom, so Shawn turns to travelers for help recovering the gift.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My friend Hilary lost her necklace, and we can't find it. We've been fishing all day right here, and we looked around here already. The only thing I can think of is that it fell into the lake. Our parents don't want us to swim in the lake... My mom says there's some mean things underwater, but you look like you aren't scared of mean things.
Could you find it for her, please?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hi. I miss my necklace. My daddy got it for me. Daddy says that there are monsters in the lake. Did you beat up any monsters?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you for finding my necklace friend adventurer... You are very kind! My kitty thanks you too - isn't that right Effsee?
